# `nvl2`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns `expr2` if `expr1` is not null, or `expr3` otherwise.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
nvl2(expr1, expr2, expr3)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `conditional_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 3 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- nvl2, example 1
> SELECT nvl2(NULL, 2, 1);
1
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 2.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
